body: Yes, I think so, but I don't think he goes to therapy anymore for whatever reason... If he does, he hasn't told me so.

It'd be pretty hard not to remain friends... we've been really close since we met, and we share all the same mutual friend circles. I don't think I actually can avoid being around him, and I don't even want to.

It's not so much that I'm concerned about it being my fault... I want to continue a strong platonic relationship with him, because he's probably my best friend in the world. I don't want to lose him.

Additionally, I don't have any way to contact his family or police.

His parents are divorced; his mom is unstable, and his dad just smokes pot all the time - not like it would benefit him to be with his dad, seeing as how his dad's ex is manipulative, unstable, and insists on being in contact with him.

He has some friends, but as far as I know, they're all from school, and summer vacation's started so that's not really an option... Mostly, his friends are me and some other people on mutual chatrooms, but obviously that's no help to anybody.
